_comment: Actor key -> Wikidata QID. Curated by hand and verified against the label and description recorded beside each id. Never generate these from a search hit without checking: 34 of 65 hand-written ids were wrong in the research for #22, and every one failed silently. Since the corpus-derived pass, candidates come from tools/actor_candidates.py and are verified here before landing: of 20 proposed, 19 held and 'roma' was rejected, because Wikidata resolved it to Romania while all 335 headlines carrying it were Italian and about the city or the football club.
